related_questions.question: How long does it take to get a PCR test for COVID?
related_questions.snippet: When should I know the results of a PCR test? The results of nasal swab tests for common viruses like influenza and COVID usually take about a day to come back. The results of genetic testing through blood tests, biopsies and other procedures can take at least a week or longer.
